notes: Primary official docs and public GitHub repositories. Suitability assessments are editorial. Official preview links are references, not claims that local demos reproduce upstream code.

sources.name: Watermelon UI
sources.license: Free MIT; no Pro tier claimed by official docs
sources.bestFor: Practical SaaS interaction patterns and realistic dashboard compositions
sources.caveat: Copying source means maintaining it; animation-heavy SSR usage needs client boundaries

demos.name: Expandable Event Card
demos.description: Card expands into a full-screen modal

demos.name: Contextual AI Bar
demos.description: Action icons morph into an AI input

demos.name: Command Search
demos.description: Sectioned command palette with keyboard navigation

sources.name: Componentry
sources.framework: React, Tailwind CSS, Motion; some GSAP/WebGL components
sources.bestFor: Distinctive hero effects, experimental type, editorial portfolios
sources.caveat: Validate touch, reduced motion and performance per component; dense particles can be expensive

demos.name: Particle Typography
demos.description: Cursor disperses spring-driven particles that reassemble as text

sources.name: Kokonut UI
sources.license: Free catalog MIT; Pro templates separately paid
sources.bestFor: Polished controls, AI inputs, compact product cards
sources.caveat: Premium template access differs from free component license

sources.name: Bklit UI
sources.license: Chart source MIT; Studio proprietary and cannot be reused/resold/redistributed without permission
sources.bestFor: Expressive dashboards and animated data storytelling
sources.caveat: Chart library and hosted Studio have different licenses

demos.name: Live Line Chart
demos.description: Streaming chart with scrolling, crosshair and animated axes

sources.name: Motion
sources.license: Core MIT; Motion+ examples and UI separately paid
sources.bestFor: Shared layout transitions, gestures, state-driven UI animation
sources.caveat: Public live previews do not imply premium source is free

sources.name: Shader Gradient
sources.framework: React + React Three Fiber + Three.js; Vue/TresJS; Framer and Figma integrations
sources.bestFor: Fluid 3D hero surfaces, gradient mesh and atmospheric backgrounds
sources.caveat: GPU load and React/R3F compatibility matter; avoid mounting many simultaneous canvases

demos.name: Gradient customizer
demos.description: Plane, sphere, waterPlane; colors, grain, lighting and motion

sources.name: Framer Marketplace
sources.license: Per-asset; free and paid; selected shaders Single-Use
sources.install: Copy asset URL into Framer canvas
sources.bestFor: Rapid site composition with designer-editable assets
sources.caveat: A Framer asset is not automatically reusable React source outside Framer

demos.name: Liquid Shader
demos.description: WebGL fluid colors, cursor distortion, optional chromatic aberration; listed $5

sources.name: Manus
sources.framework: Hosted conversational full-stack builder; full code export advertised
sources.license: Commercial service; generated application ownership advertised; inspect export dependencies separately
sources.bestFor: Rapid whole-site prototyping and app exploration
sources.caveat: A building tool rather than a component library; public pricing page did not expose plan amounts to crawler

demos.name: Awesome Manus web-app showcase
demos.description: Official linked gallery of built websites

sources.name: Khroma
sources.license: Hosted tool; code license not established
sources.install: Choose preferred colors to train the browser-based generator
sources.bestFor: Personalized palette, typography and gradient comparisons
sources.caveat: Color proposals still need contextual accessibility testing

demos.name: Khroma generator
demos.description: Train color preferences; inspect typography, gradients, palettes and WCAG pair ratings

sources.name: ColorKit.io
sources.license: Hosted tool; code license and pricing not established
sources.install: Enter start/end colors and blend-step count
sources.bestFor: Constructing stepped color scales for tokens and charts
sources.caveat: This exact domain is a color blender; do not conflate it with colorkit.tools or colorkit.app

demos.name: Color Blender
demos.description: Intermediate shades; URL and SVG export, CSS export described as coming soon
